# seis-hielo (ORM, docs/SEIS_BLOQUES_11_20.md, PLAN_100 F14, box 6 of block 14. Caverna de Hielo):
# one game and five bots. A warps into IceCavern (IceCavern_FromZoraFountain, adult) and walks its key rooms with
# place (recorridos_adulto.py's); the bots (seis-hielo.bots.txt) come in from ZoraFountain_Adult after it
# and follow it 3 m off. In the first room A falls and bots 3 and 4 lift it; then bot5 sends a room's flag
# (A's game takes it 0 -> 1) and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it.
# Generated by tools/harness/seis_adulto.py: edit its tables, not this file. Run (orm/rama-unica's harness):
#   python -I tools/orm/harness/r03_pareja.py --scenario seis-hielo --scen-dir tools/orm/harness/escenarios
# 1 game, 5 bots, puppets and min-fps 25 come from the name (seis-*); transport and bot-arg are in the .bots.txt.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves entrada-adulto-hielo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_OBJECTS=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_BOSS=1,LICHII_COOP_STORY=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt,LICHII_COOP_DOWNED=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_LIFE=1
#! timeout 486
#! expect A coop: test warp done
#! never A coop: test goto timed out
#! never A coop: test place .*: failed
#! never A coop: test warp to .* did not happen
#! never A coop: server refused
#! count A coop: player \d+ 'bot\d' joined >= 5 within boot..
#! never A coop: puppet: P\d+ CoopPuppet_\w+ not spawned after
#! expect A coop: downed: P\d is down \(PLAYER_STATUS dead\)
#! expect A coop: downed: P\d is up again
#! never A group defeat: GROUP_DEFEAT
#! never A -> game_over
#! never A coop: boss: Link's actor (is gone|not found)
#! expect A coop: lists: .*shared_dungeon_adult\.txt: \d+ flags and keys added within boot..
#! count A coop: puppet: P\d+ CoopPuppet_Adult spawned >= 5
#! expect A coop: downed: alive -> downed within caida..levantado
#! expect A downed -> reviving: revive requested by P\d within caida..levantado
#! expect A reviving -> alive: revived \(by P\d within caida..levantado
#! expect A coop: test place 17\.30 103\.30 79\.80: done within r01-hielo-rojo..caida
#! expect A coop: test place 0\.00 100\.80 35\.90: done within r02-caverna..r03-muro-rojo
#! expect A coop: test place 7\.30 106\.20 \-13\.40: done within r03-muro-rojo..r04-rupias
#! expect A coop: test place \-32\.10 101\.00 \-20\.40: done within r04-rupias..r05-mapa
#! expect A coop: test place 18\.40 104\.30 \-57\.70: done within r05-mapa..r06-lobo-blanco
#! expect A coop: test place \-46\.20 110\.60 36\.60: done within r06-lobo-blanco..fin
#! expect A coop: flags debug: \w+ 0x49eb1639 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within caida..fin
#! never A coop: flags debug: \w+ 0x49eb1639 \(entry \d+\) 1 -> 0
mark start
warp IceCavern IceCavern_FromZoraFountain adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 1200               # the five bots follow A into IceCavern
mark r01-hielo-rojo     # the first red ice
place 17.30 103.30 79.80
wait 300
mark caida              # A falls here: bots 3 and 4 come and hold A beside it
life 0
wait 2400               # their 3.5 s and the game's 6 s revive
mark levantado          # then bot5 sends the flag and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it
wait 600
mark r02-caverna        # the first cavern
place 0.00 100.80 35.90
wait 300
wait 900
mark r03-muro-rojo      # the room with the red ice wall
place 7.30 106.20 -13.40
wait 300
wait 900
mark r04-rupias         # the silver rupees and the push block
place -32.10 101.00 -20.40
wait 300
wait 900
mark r05-mapa           # the map room
place 18.40 104.30 -57.70
wait 300
wait 900
mark r06-lobo-blanco    # the White Wolfos (the Iron Boots)
place -46.20 110.60 36.60
wait 300
wait 900
mark fin
